extractions.description: Introduces and releases PAIRBENCH, a benchmark framework and four derived datasets for inference-only evaluation of vision-language models on image–image and image–text comparison, and evaluates 23 VLM configurations plus vision encoders using named scoring metrics and transformations.

type.quote: We carried out an extensive evaluation covering several state-of-the-art VLMs, both proprietary and open-source, multiple dataset configurations, and different prompt templates.
type.justification: The paper conducts experiments, human annotation, model inference, metric computation, and numerical comparisons.

name.quote: Understanding how effectively large vision language models (VLMs) compare visual inputs is crucial
name.justification: The paper directly evaluates vision-language models.
